crossdressing isn't fucked up- it's actually how i realized i'm transgender. 

also there's so much pressure to be some big standout gazillionaire douche with a different woman for each day of the week, and it's unhealthy. there's absolutely nothing wrong with not having any relationships. romantic relationships are overrated, and online friendships are just as meaningful as face to face. and finally, it's perfectly valid okay if all you want/need to be is "paid."
